title: Nil-Bohr Sets and Sums with Bounded Gaps
summary: We study the relation between $\NilBohr{d}$ sets and $\SG_d^*$ sets. We prove that every $\NilBohr{d}$ set is an $\SG_d^*$ set, answering a question of Host and Kra. More generally, for a compact Hausdorff distal system whose Ellis group admits a closed filtration \[ E=E_1\supseteq E_2\supseteq\cdots\supseteq E_{d+1}=\{e\}, \ [E_j,E]\subseteq E_{j+1}, \] we prove that every return time set is an $\SG_d^*$ set.
